title: Reports
content:
# Reports

Run GA4 reports and realtime reports on a connected property, and list the dimensions and metrics it supports.

Every call takes the `accountId` of a connected Google Analytics account. Zernio passes the request to Google's Data API and returns Google's response as it is, with `accountId` and `propertyId` added.

## Run a report

Pick 1 to 10 metrics and up to 9 dimensions, using their GA4 API names:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://zernio.com/api/v1/analytics/googleanalytics/report" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "accountId": "ACCOUNT_ID",
    "metrics": ["sessions", "activeUsers"],
    "dimensions": ["sessionSource"],
    "dateRanges": [{ "startDate": "7daysAgo", "endDate": "yesterday" }],
    "orderBys": [{ "metric": { "metricName": "sessions" }, "desc": true }],
    "limit": 10
  }'
```

```json
{
  "accountId": "ACCOUNT_ID",
  "propertyId": "123456789",
  "dimensionHeaders": [{ "name": "sessionSource" }],
  "metricHeaders": [{ "name": "sessions", "type": "TYPE_INTEGER" }, { "name": "activeUsers", "type": "TYPE_INTEGER" }],
  "rows": [
    { "dimensionValues": [{ "value": "google" }], "metricValues": [{ "value": "1840" }, { "value": "1502" }] }
  ],
  "rowCount": 24,
  "metadata": { "currencyCode": "USD", "timeZone": "America/Los_Angeles" },
  "propertyQuota": { "tokensPerDay": { "consumed": 12, "remaining": 199988 } }
}
```

Every value in `rows` is a string, even numbers. Convert them using the type in `metricHeaders`.

## Request fields

| Field | What it does |
|-------|--------------|
| `metrics` | 1 to 10 metric names, such as `sessions` or `screenPageViews`. Required. |
| `dimensions` | Up to 9 dimension names, such as `date` or `pagePath`. |
| `dateRanges` | Up to 4 ranges of `startDate` and `endDate`, each `YYYY-MM-DD`, `today`, `yesterday` or `NdaysAgo`. Defaults to `28daysAgo` to `yesterday`. |
| `dimensionFilter`, `metricFilter` | A filter expression in Google's own shape. |
| `orderBys` | Up to 10 sort orders in Google's own shape. |
| `limit`, `offset` | Rows per page (up to 10,000) and the row to start from. Page with `offset` until you reach `rowCount`. |
| `keepEmptyRows` | Return rows whose metrics are all zero. |
| `currencyCode` | ISO 4217 code for currency metrics. Defaults to the property's currency. |

Filters and sort orders follow Google's [runReport](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1/rest/v1beta/properties/runReport) reference.

## Run a realtime report

Call `POST /v1/analytics/googleanalytics/realtime` for activity in the last 30 minutes. It takes the same `metrics`, `dimensions`, filters, `orderBys` and `limit`, plus optional `minuteRanges`:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://zernio.com/api/v1/analytics/googleanalytics/realtime" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "accountId": "ACCOUNT_ID", "metrics": ["activeUsers"], "dimensions": ["country"] }'
```

Realtime reports take no `dateRanges`, `offset`, `keepEmptyRows` or `currencyCode`.

## List dimensions and metrics

Call `GET /v1/analytics/googleanalytics/metadata` to see every name the property accepts, custom definitions included:

```bash
curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/analytics/googleanalytics/metadata?accountId=ACCOUNT_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "accountId": "ACCOUNT_ID",
  "propertyId": "123456789",
  "dimensions": [{ "apiName": "sessionSource", "uiName": "Session source", "description": "…", "category": "Traffic source", "customDefinition": false }],
  "metrics": [{ "apiName": "sessions", "uiName": "Sessions", "description": "…", "category": "Session", "customDefinition": false, "type": "TYPE_INTEGER" }]
}
```

## How it behaves

- Identical report requests on the same property are cached for 10 minutes. Metadata is cached for 1 hour. Realtime reports are never cached.
- Google meters each property. A property gets 200,000 tokens a day and 40,000 an hour, and all Zernio users share 14,000 tokens an hour per property. `propertyQuota` shows what is left.
- Hourly quotas refill within the hour. Daily quotas refill at midnight Pacific time.
- A larger date range, more dimensions or a higher `limit` costs more tokens. A cached response costs none.
- Zernio also reads each connected property once a day (around 07:30 UTC) to keep daily totals per source and campaign. The first read covers about 13 months; later ones cover the last few days and use a few tokens.

## If it fails

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `400` | A field is invalid, or Google rejected a dimension or metric name; the message names it | Check the name against the metadata endpoint. |
| `403` | The Google account lost access to the property, or removed Zernio | Reconnect Google Analytics. |
| `404` | The account does not exist, is not a Google Analytics account, or your key cannot reach it | List your accounts with `GET /v1/accounts?category=analytics`. |
| `429` with `rate_limited` | Google's quota for the property is used up | Retry after the quota refills, and reuse cached requests where you can. |
